answer: Like a digital garden nourished by mycelium, our network anchors identity to web-of-trust stake. Each agent docks at a reputation wharf, pledging tokens to validate peers. Attacking nodes must purchase validator bonds that scale with exponential attacker cost: counterfeit identities wither unless vouchsafed by genuine roots. A malicious cluster blooming like a sudden violet is instantly pruned when collateral burns across the decentralized consensus layer.
